_comment: TDM few-step distillation (krea2/train_tdm.py) with role-based LoRA: one frozen 12.8B base + a student adapter (standard lora_A/lora_B keys) + a fake-score adapter (lora_A_fake/lora_B_fake). Data-free w.r.t. images — the parquet dataset supplies captions (and preview ground truth). The student is a tdm_steps-step CFG-free sampler; the saved tdm_student_*.safetensors loads directly into inference.py --lora with --steps 4 and guidance 0. Works for every parallelism (override with --parallelism/--devices).
_comment_grad_accum: 'cpu' for LoRA-sized trainables — 22% faster than 'stream' (see memory/worklog.md).
_comment_grad_ckpt: MUST stay true at this batch: RamTorch stage workers run forwards on their own threads where the driver's (thread-local) no_grad does not apply, so even infer() builds graphs and keeps activations alive - per-block checkpointing collapses that from ~5 GB to ~0.5 GB per in-flight sample (2026-08-18 probes).
_comment_batch: Probed 2026-08-18 at 512px on 4x RTX PRO 6000: 12x8=96 samples -> 161 s/iter (0.60 samples/s), peak 49.7 GB driver. 8x8 was 0.56 samp/s; scaling flattens past 96.
_comment_lr: Demo recipe: fake-score LR ~5x the student LR, betas (0, 0.95), clip 1.0 on both.
_comment_tdm: tdm_steps = K (student sampling steps). tdm_cfg = teacher guidance baked into the student. tdm_separate_intervals keeps each segment's diffused tau range non-overlapping (paper default); tdm_randmid is the demo's optional mid-point regularizer. tdm_huber enables the Pseudo-Huber surrogate objective for the student update.
_comment_decoupled: Decoupled DMD (arXiv:2511.22677): the DMD target splits as DM + (tdm_cfg-1)*CA with DM = x0_real - x0_fake (regularizer) and CA = x0_real - x0_unc (engine) — at cfg 4.5 that is a lopsided 1:3.5 whose true balance drifts with |DM|. tdm_ca_ratio = lam replaces it with a normalized mix where CA carries exactly lam of the step's mean-abs magnitude and DM the rest (magnitude anchored to the legacy delta, so lr/loss scales transfer). null = legacy math. tdm_dm_floor = gamma floors DM's normalizer at gamma*mean|CA| so a near-zero DM (early training / matched distributions) fades out instead of being amplified to unit scale.
_comment_ratio: !! WARNING (2026-08-21): the ratio rescale caused training instability in practice — keep tdm_ca_ratio null (legacy math) until rediagnosed, see memory/worklog.md. (For reference, the cfg-3 equivalent mix was lam = 0.667 with tdm_cfg 3.0.)
_comment_teacher: Teacher = latest full FT (x0-pred krea2-fullft run, step 49600, fp32 -> cast to bf16 on load).
_comment_data: Same 5-source caption mix the teacher was fine-tuned on (from the fullft run's config). TDM only consumes captions; images are decoded solely for preview ground truth, so worker count is modest.
